status.summary: Former UFC welterweight champion (won the title from Belal Muhammad at UFC 315, May 10, 2025; lost it to Islam Makhachev at UFC 322, Nov 15, 2025, UD). Carlos Prates then stopped him in the UFC Perth main event (May 2, 2026; TKO R3 3:17), his second straight loss. Pro record 18-4, UFC 8-2 (ESPN, Wikipedia, MMA Junkie). Ranked #4 at welterweight on both UFC lists. No fight is booked: he turned down a spot on UFC Sydney (Feb 7, 2027 local) because the turnaround was too short, said he would be into a fight with Mike Malott, and is targeting April or May 2027 after time spent developing his game (Bedtime MMA interview, reported Nov 1-2, 2026 by MMA Mania and NY Fights). Shavkat Rakhmonov has also been mentioned as an opponent; a Bloody Elbow report (Oct 30, 2026) that Rakhmonov's manager shut down a rumored January fight could not be read directly (403). No injury reported in the coverage checked.
status.ranking: #4 welterweight (UFC media panel, Nov 3-5, 2026; also #4 in the Meta UFC Rankings of Oct 31, 2026; read from ufcrankings.org and ufcalendar.com mirrors because ufc.com returned 403). Not in the men's pound-for-pound top 15.

signature: punches to the body: KO of Ramazan Emeev with a punch to the body, R1 2:32 (UFC 275; ufcstats 'Punch to Body At Distance')
heavy body work: 19.5% of decayed significant attempts go to the body (division 13.9%); 47/65 body strikes landed against Muhammad
early finishing power: his first four UFC opponents (Rodriguez, Emeev, Roberts, Brown) were all finished in R1 (2022-2023)
fifth-round surge: 53/83 significant strikes landed in R5 against Muhammad to win the title
finishes hurt opponents on the ground: elbows to Gilbert Burns, R3 3:43 (UFC 299), and a rear-naked choke of Randy Brown, R1 (UFC 284), each after a knockdown
weaknesses: takedown defense 41.7% over the last 3 years (division 64.1%). Makhachev went 4/4 and controlled him 19:10, and Burns went 7/11 with 5:07 control
almost no wrestling offense: 0.48 takedowns per 15 min decayed (division 1.35), 25% accuracy
knocked down three times and stopped by Prates (May 2026), his first UFC loss by KO/TKO
two straight losses; Bassil Hafez also controlled him 6:48 (3/20 takedowns) in a 2023 split decision
style.summary: A switch-stance boxer who builds behind straight punches, attacks the body, and turns it up late: he landed 53 significant strikes in the fifth round to take the title from Muhammad. He finished each of his first four UFC opponents in round 1. His weak spot is the mat, where wrestlers have controlled him for long spells. Carlos Prates knocked him down three times and finished him in May 2026.

moves.notes: Target split from the fighters.json S sums: decayed significant attempts go 73.3% head, 19.5% body, 7.2% legs, and landed strikes 63.1% head, 25.7% body, 11.2% legs. Career attempts are 73.8/19.5/6.7. His body share is about 1.4x the welterweight rate (13.9%), and a punch to the body finished Emeev, so the body moves total 0.9. They lean to punches (body hook 0.4, body straight 0.3) over kicks (0.2). Leg attempts are below the division rate (9.3%), so low kicks are small. 88% of his decayed landed strikes come at distance and 7.8% in the clinch, so knees and elbows are small. His elbow finish of Burns was on the ground. ufcstats does not split jab, cross, hook and uppercut. That split follows his boxing style as a judgment, not a count. No outside scouting source could be fetched this pass.

engine_notes.note: Fast starts in three-round fights: 6.89 significant landed per minute in round 1 across 7 three-round fights, with 4 first-round finishes.

Five-round pace (1, 1.23, 1.06, 1.09, 1.72) comes from 2 fights that reached round 5 (Muhammad, Makhachev). The round-5 jump mostly comes from the Muhammad fight (53 landed in R5), so shrink it toward the prior.
Grappling defense is the hole: controlled 331 s per 15 min over the last 3 years (division 167).
Chin: all 3 knockdowns he has absorbed in the UFC came in the Prates fight (1 in R2, 2 in R3). Before that he was never knocked down in 105 UFC minutes.
